description: This file is a shell script defining functions for platform-specific firmware upgrade procedures, including checking the image and performing the upgrade on a specific hardware platform (RT3883).

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the validity of the firmware image, always returns success (0).

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the system upgrade by invoking the default upgrade procedure based on the detected board name.
